report actual effective-capacity difference before running

stopping.budget: 30 maximum; best=30 is truncated, no automatic extension; smoke not extra epochs
stopping.final: If prediction/interaction readiness fails, stop new social algorithm development; next action belongs to user, no hidden hyperparameter/seed search

stopping.numerical: Any nonfinite, target mismatch, future-valued input dependency or OOM stops affected run; no blind retry

target_cohort: Same supervised targets as frozen Stage5.1 B, regrouped into synchronous complete20 offline contexts, including N1. Not the Causal-context protocol.
